text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the SWBC behind them, a new year 
began. The Trainers looked back fondly on 
the hoofprints they had forged alongside 
their Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The wisdom imparted by the Three 
Goddesses—deep beneath it all, I hoped 
that our own journey would also be passed 
down, just like the Umamusume and Trainers 
of old.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume who race through to the SWBC and 
come closest to the very pinnacle receive 
an invitation to the Grand Masters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Three Goddesses—rulers of the data of 
countless Umamusume and owners of the 
pinnacle of racing technique. The showdown 
against these three was finally about to 
begin...!
